topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines the scope of the session.

topics.label: Innate recognition of pathogens and cellular damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system identifies infections and tissue injury through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Cellular dynamics and physiological outcomes of acute inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular signaling, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic physiological effects that occur during acute inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the passive and active mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue healing, and manage persistent inflammatory conditions.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation and previews the upcoming lecture on the complement system.
